name: m5-backend-prof
description: Does `BackendBenchmark` amplify the backend? A real compile of the scala corpus in setup, then the jvm phase over its trees (`phase`) and `ClassNode` to bytes (`write`). Read the share of frame computation and of codegen, against about 0.35% and 6% of CPU samples in a full compile.
One fork, async cpu and alloc. Upstream `2.13.x` at `c84dea8aa7`, built with the release optimizer settings; patched JDK 26, 8G heap.
